; Hot-reload demo: swap the toolbar Tags tool icon, live.
;
;   scp demo/tag-icon.qmd root@10.11.99.1:/home/root/hot-reload/
;
; Open any document so the toolbar is visible: the tag icon becomes the
; cloud-upload icon WITHOUT restarting xochitl. Edit the icon name below
; (eye, cog, keyboard, accessibility, ...) and scp again — it changes again.

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/TagsMenu.qml
    TRAVERSE ToolbarTool#root
        REPLACE iconSource WITH {
            iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/cloud_upload"
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
